annotations.title: Get goals and CTA check settings

description:
[read-only] The brand's goals (source tagged, implicit from the website, or none; the primary goal) and its CTA check settings (ctaLevel, ctaPaidLevel, organicSupportingHosts, autoApplyPrimaryCta). Free. Needs the Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/hook-studio/cta-settings.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.
